# Night Shift

Night Shift is an optional, fixed dark theme in the existing Appearance catalog's Custom category. Search for Night Shift, FNAF, or Five Nights at Freddy's. Selecting it uses the existing personal and shared-display permissions and persistence; paired displays keep their Preview, Cancel, and Confirm behavior. It changes no default selections or stored Task/Note color slots.

The design uses charcoal metal, amber light, checkerboard trim, and a still pizzeria camera illustration. The thirteen existing color slots retain their identities and resolve through the theme palette with readable text and status roles. Decorative artwork is scoped to Night Shift's dashboard/wall header and preview tile; changing or clearing the theme removes it. The illustration is decorative and has no interactive or essential text. Forced-colors mode hides it. There are no animations, jump scares, or strobing effects.

Theme-default sound feedback is silent. An explicit sound-pack choice remains independent; Off and zero volume continue to win. Selecting Night Shift never rewrites sound preferences.

`public/assets/themes/night-shift-stage.svg` is original SVG fan art authored for this theme, based on its approved local prototype. No game assets were downloaded or extracted. The theme is unofficial and has no official affiliation or endorsement.

The asset is included in the existing service-worker precache list. Release composition must regenerate `public/named-appearance-init.js` from the shared model and allocate the combined cache version; this theme contribution does not allocate a schema migration or cache generation.
